title: Decision Gate
summary: YTIntel now tells you whether a competitor analysis is strong enough to act on instead of treating every interesting video like a proven opportunity.
changes: Added a GO / TEST / HOLD verdict after every deep analysis.
Added an evidence sufficiency score using transcript, Most Replayed, channel-baseline sample size, source receipts, hook evidence and Sol intelligence.
Added hard confidence caps for missing transcripts, tiny baseline samples and videos that are not genuine channel outliers.
Added bias warnings for stale uploads, missing replay evidence, weak source receipts and control-like performance.
Added exact next-research actions when the evidence is not strong enough to justify full production yet.
Added one-click Decision Brief export and refreshed the PWA cache so installed copies receive v0.11.1.
why_it_matters: The new gate reduces false confidence. YTIntel can now tell you when the evidence supports building, when an idea only deserves a cheap test, and when you should keep researching instead of wasting production time.
